svg.aria-label: Sharing, synchronization, and freshness. How Superbee classifies bundle channels, refreshes reads, converges shared changes, and preserves conflicting work.
svg.title: Superbee sharing synchronization and freshness
svg.desc: Superbee classifies a bundle from Git evidence as local-only, in-tree, or a dedicated board branch. Local-only stays local until establishment. In-tree awareness fetches the configured tracking upstream while normal Git delivers changes. A stale branch-mode read may perform a bounded fast-forward pull. Full sync commits, converges, preserves conflicts as exports, pushes safe results, and records awareness.
